Discover ING Hubs Romania ING Hubs Romania offers 180 services in tech, data and analytics, non-financial risk and compliance to ING units worldwide. We started in 2015 as ING’s software development centre and have since grown into a global capability hub, continuously expanding our services and expertise. Today, more than 2,300 professionals design and deliver digital products for easier banking everywhere, working across key domains including: Tech Foundation and Channels​, Core Banking and Architecture​, Data and Analytics, Global Products and Technology Services, Payment and Settlement Services, Risk Services​ and Product and Operations. From engineers and data experts to risk specialists, product and operations professionals and beyond, our colleagues enjoy a flexible way of working and a collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things, one innovative solution at a time.
Discover ING Hubs RomaniaING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals. We started out in 2015 as INGs software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate from two locations: Bucharest and Cluj-Napoca. Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data and Analytics Tech, Tech Foundation and Channels, Retail Core Banking and Architecture, and Global Products and Technology Services. We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. For us, impact isnt a perk. Its the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you? Heres a sneak peak of what our colleagues say about working within ING Hubs Romania:At ING, were building the solutions of tomorrow, today | 80% of our colleagues in Romania agreeThe MissionAt ING, DevOps means much more than automation. We follow Scrum and Continuous Delivery Engineering Practices, integrating development, testing, deployment, operations, monitoring, and decommissioning into one continuous lifecycle.By improving and automating everything we touch, we increase INGs operational excellence and customer satisfaction across Financial Markets.As part of the Proximity Hosting Solutions team, you will help deliver, maintain, automate, and support a high-tech Market-to-Market, low-latency connectivity platform used by DevOps teams and Financial Markets applications. You will work on externally hosted (private cloud) infrastructure environments for Financial Markets -- a fast-paced, complex, and continuously evolving area where quality and resilience are critical.Our team manages the complete infrastructure hosted in Equinix Data Centres in Frankfurt and operated by Getronics. This environment supports critical Financial Markets platforms such as KDB, Ullink, MarketView, GEP, and Horizon--core systems enabling ING to conduct global trading activities, including on the Eurex Frankfurt Exchange.As a DevOps Engineer, your mission is to ensure our platforms remain stable, automated, secure, and ready to scale.
